title: War and Peace
author: Leo Tolstoy
summary: Following several aristocratic Russian families across the Napoleonic Wars, this enormous novel moves between drawing rooms and battlefields while its characters search for love, purpose and meaning.
readIf: you want a monumental novel that is far more readable and human than its reputation suggests.
skipIf: you don't have the time or patience for essays on history and a very large cast.

pairings.reason: Tolstoy's other great novel, tighter and more focused on love, marriage and consequence.
Another big, humane classic about individuals caught in a nation's upheaval.
A far lighter and more charming take on Russian history and aristocrats, at a manageable length.
